C_ULTRASONIC_TRIGGER_MSG0: Send an ultrasonic trigger pulse on pin %1
C_ULTRASONIC_TRIGGER_TOOLTIP: An ultrasonic module fires only after it receives a 10 microsecond HIGH pulse. This block stands for five lines: pull LOW for 2 microseconds to settle, HIGH for 10, then LOW again. Then use "read pulse width" for the echo time; multiply by 0.034 and divide by 2 for centimetres.
